business: Nutrition Depot Houston and Greater Houston

decisionFraming.decisionQuestion: Should Nutrition Depot Houston / Greater Houston be treated as a high-priority executive outreach target for Smoothie Depot franchise-development evaluation?
decisionFraming.decisionThesis: Nutrition Depot deserves the top current executive outreach-preparation position because it combines category adjacency, public operator identification, multi-location signals, strong Pasadena customer reputation, ecommerce sophistication, fitness/wellness audience access, and a credible path to a second-concept conversation.
decisionFraming.recommendedExecutivePosture: Lead with operator respect and strategic curiosity. Treat the conversation as qualification and relationship development, not a pitch.
decisionFraming.confidence: Medium-high that Ivan Valdes is the key Pasadena / Clear Lake operator; medium that Nutrition Depot is an attractive Smoothie Depot expansion target; medium-low that all Houston-area Nutrition Depot assets are under common control.

keyCorrectionsFromV1: Added Prometheus-branded cover, explicit package metadata, executive decision page, and no founder review controls.
Replaced shallow ownership unknown with Ivan Valdes operator/control analysis supported by public sources.
Separated confirmed storefronts from broader Nutrition Depot network signals.
Added website and ecommerce catalog intelligence.
Added public reputation analysis from Birdeye, indexed review signals, Grubhub, Facebook snippets, and Glassdoor.
Added social presence analysis from Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Nutrition Depot Online public signals.
Named actual Houston / Greater Houston competitors and channel substitutes.
Replaced generic unknowns with checked-source unknowns and verification paths.

ownershipFinding.label: Corroborated / Owner-provided / Inference
ownershipFinding.finding: Ivan Valdes appears to be the public operator and likely controlling owner for Nutrition Depot Pasadena and Clear Lake. Legal ownership is not fully verified. Public evidence does not yet prove that Ivan controls the Houston / Southwest Freeway storefront or Nutrition Depot Online.
evidenceBasis: Pasadena Chamber identifies Ivan Valdes as Rep/Contact for Nutrition Depot Pasadena.
ChamberVu Pasadena 2024 guide lists Nutrition Depot Pasadena with Ivan Valdes, address, phone, and Health & Wellness category.

VoyageHouston attributes to Ivan a detailed operator history: started with Nutrition Depot in 2008, became Pasadena manager in 2012, purchased Pasadena in 2021, acquired Clear Lake in 2024, and owns/operates two Nutrition Depot storefronts.
LinkedIn public search identifies Ivan Valdes as Manager at Nutrition Depot in Pasadena.
Instagram public search-index snippets state the Pasadena account became owners of Clear Lake and that Clear Lake was the second store.
ownershipFinding.sourceReliability: Medium-high for operator identification; medium for owner narrative; medium-low for social snippets; low for legal entity structure.
ownershipFinding.confidenceLevel: Medium-high for Ivan as Pasadena/Clear Lake operator; medium for owner/control status; low for ownership beyond Pasadena/Clear Lake.
ownershipFinding.verificationNeeded: Confirm legal entity names, current authority, whether Ivan controls Houston/Southwest Freeway, whether Nutrition Depot Online is connected, and whether other partners have decision rights.
ownershipFinding.businessDecisionImpact: v2 supports a targeted executive conversation with Ivan Valdes or the current decision-maker while preserving caution around legal control.

ivanValdesFinding.label: Owner-provided / Corroborated
ivanValdesFinding.finding: Ivan Valdes' public relationship to Nutrition Depot appears meaningful and operator-level, centered on Pasadena and Clear Lake.
ivanValdesFinding.sourceReliability: Medium-high for operator identification; medium for timeline details; medium-low for exact ownership economics.
ivanValdesFinding.verificationNeeded: Current role, legal ownership, partner rights, and whether Ivan is the right person for a Smoothie Depot franchise-development conversation.
ivanValdesFinding.businessDecisionImpact: Executive preparation should acknowledge the visible Pasadena-to-Clear-Lake path and ask how the operator evaluates expansion now.

websiteEcommerceIntelligence.label: Observed / Corroborated
websiteEcommerceIntelligence.summary: Nutrition Depot has deeper digital/ecommerce sophistication than v1 recognized.
findings: Official Houston site lists supplement categories, InBody Scale services, address, phone, and hours.
Nutrition Depot Online has ecommerce taxonomy across Protein, Workout Enhancement, Muscle Builders, Weight Loss, Vitamins & Minerals, General Health, Food & Snacks, Accessories, and Brands.
Product pages show SKU count/filter sophistication, brand filters, pricing, sold-out status, payment rails, newsletter capture, and detailed product merchandising.

Brand list includes 1st Phorm, 5% Nutrition, Alani Nu, Alpha Lion, APS, Axe and Sledge, Black Magic, Blackmarket Labs, BSN, Cellucor, Celsius, Core, Dymatize, Ghost, Glaxon, Gorilla Mind, Hi-Tech, Jocko Fuel, KULT, and others.
websiteEcommerceIntelligence.sourceReliability: High for public website/ecommerce observations; medium-low for ownership linkage between Nutrition Depot Online and Ivan.
websiteEcommerceIntelligence.confidenceLevel: High that ecommerce/product sophistication exists; low-medium that it is controlled by the same operator.
websiteEcommerceIntelligence.verificationNeeded: Determine whether Ivan/Pasadena/Clear Lake operate or feed into ndonline.com and whether local stores support pickup, fulfillment, or inventory sync.
websiteEcommerceIntelligence.businessDecisionImpact: If connected, Nutrition Depot has more advanced retail systems and digital thinking than a typical local storefront.

reputationAnalysis.label: Corroborated / Inference
reputationAnalysis.summary: Pasadena public reputation is strong enough to support executive outreach preparation. Clear Lake is directionally positive but less quantified. Houston/Southwest Freeway reputation is too thin to rely on.
signals: Birdeye / Google aggregation for Pasadena shows 4.9 stars and 347 reviews, with excerpts praising helpful customer service, selection, prices, and courteous employees.
Facebook Pasadena public search snippet shows 88% recommend across 28 reviews.
Wheree indexed snippets for Pasadena and Clear Lake emphasize knowledgeable staff, helpfulness, expertise, competitive prices, and positive shopping experience.
Grubhub Houston indexed listing shows a low-volume 4.2 rating across 5 ratings.

Glassdoor Nutrition Depot shows 3.7 rating across 16 reviews, 59% recommend, with employee positives around knowledge/discounts/customer interaction and risks around pay, benefits, management, and advancement.
reputationAnalysis.sourceReliability: Medium for Pasadena; medium-low for Clear Lake; low-medium for Houston; medium for employee-level signal.
reputationAnalysis.confidenceLevel: Medium-high for Pasadena customer experience; medium-low for Clear Lake and Houston patterns.
reputationAnalysis.verificationNeeded: Ask which location has the strongest customer base, whether reviews are actively managed, how complaints are handled, and whether staff expertise is formalized in training.
reputationAnalysis.businessDecisionImpact: Strong staff-advice reputation is relevant to Smoothie Depot because smoothie franchise execution requires customer education, menu recommendation, upsell discipline, and repeat-purchase service habits.

socialPresenceAnalysis.label: Observed / Inference
socialPresenceAnalysis.summary: Public social signals exist for Pasadena, Clear Lake, Nutrition Depot Online, and broader Nutrition Depot network pages. Direct Instagram/Facebook extraction was limited, so social snippets are treated as directional unless corroborated.
signals: Nutrition Depot Pasadena Instagram public snippet shows 3,631 followers, 1,894 following, specialty supplement store, product availability DMs, 6065 Fairmont Parkway, and phone (281) 991-3113.
Nutrition Depot Clear Lake Instagram public snippet shows 2.2K+ followers, 1.6K+ posts, phone (281) 557-1269, hours, and Pasadena account linkage.
Instagram indexed post states Clear Lake became the second store.
Facebook Pasadena and Clear Lake public/search snippets show store presence, product posts, recommendation signal, and Ivan association snippets.
Nutrition Depot Online public social snippets show a broader retail-location/ecommerce network that may be separate from Ivan's Pasadena/Clear Lake footprint.
socialPresenceAnalysis.sourceReliability: Medium-low because much of the social evidence is search-indexed or platform-limited.
socialPresenceAnalysis.confidenceLevel: Medium for social presence existence; low-medium for ownership/control conclusions from social alone.
socialPresenceAnalysis.verificationNeeded: Confirm official social accounts, current ownership, account managers, promotional cadence, and whether online/social assets are connected to the operator.
socialPresenceAnalysis.businessDecisionImpact: Social presence supports public activity and product-promotion maturity, but should not substitute for direct operator verification.
